title: Kula Today
heading: Today
summary: Cloudbase is at its highest of the day and still edging up. Kula Ag had full sun over the last hour; the cloud tops out between about 6,900 and 8,500 ft, with sun above it. Upslope has run since about 07:45 at a light 3 mph, and thermals seem flat. Trades are holding the shear line north of Pukalani, reaching the coast near Haiku, with trade air reaching the lower west slope at Pulehu.
